title: Estero Island Parasail - DiamondHead
specs: Anyone age 5 and up can fly.
The minimum weight required to parasail alone is roughly 150 pounds.
If the flyer is less than 150 pounds, they will need to fly tandem with someone else.
Due to our equipment manufacturers' guidelines, the maximum weight for a single flyer is 300 lbs and the maximum combined weight (for up to three participants) is 500 lbs.
You must bring your photo ID.
If the flyer is less than 150 pounds, they will simply fly tandem with someone not to exceed approximately 500 pounds combined weight.
